otherServices.title: Dirt bikes, four-wheelers, and jobs not listed
otherServices.body:
Cars are the main lessons. I also teach basic maintenance on dirt bikes and four-wheelers - oil, chains, tires, filters, the stuff that keeps them running.

Need something that is not on this page? Message me and ask. If I can teach it on your machine, we will figure it out.

packages.name: Oil Lesson
packages.summary: Ninety minutes. Oil and filter. They crawl under, they drain it, they put it back. Next oil change they already know.
packages.hero: About 90 minutes. Oil + filter. Tire rotation or spare tire and jack is +$40 the same day.
includes: On your vehicle, in your driveway
Want a tire rotation or the spare tire and jack the same day? Add $40 each. Either skill by itself is $65 - message me.

packages.name: Core 3
packages.summary: Oil, spare tire, and one-axle brakes. The three things that leave them stranded.
packages.hero: Oil, spare tire, and brake pads on one axle. Featured. Split visits if needed.
includes: Oil + spare tire + brake pads on two wheels (front or rear)
Split across visits if a Saturday is not enough
Brake day is the long one - already in the $230
$25 less than booking those three separate
Want a tire rotation the same visit? Add $40.

packages.name: Full Basics
packages.summary: Leaving for school, a job, or a long drive? Core 3 (oil, spare tire, brakes), then rotors, then two extras they will actually hit.
packages.hero: Core 3 (oil, spare tire, brakes) + rotors + two extras (head lights/tail lights, spark plugs / coil packs, fluids checks, or air/cabin filters).
includes: Core 3, plus rotors - oil, spare tire, and one-axle brakes included
Two extras you pick: head lights/tail lights, spark plugs / coil packs, fluids checks, or air/cabin filters.
Best if they are about to drive on their own
Want a tire rotation the same visit? Add $40.
